scope: Any year · under 20k miles · clean title · nationwide
title: What Each Car Has Been Through
lead: 52 Spider listings under 20k miles on CARFAX. 7 ranked, every CARFAX read line by line.
facts: Pick: 2021 at Ilusso Costa Mesa, 5,287 mi
Cheapest one is a branded title
takeaway: My two cents: buy the 2021 at Ilusso in Costa Mesa. Low miles, dealer service, no repairs, and you can see it today. Recent sales put 2020-21 Spiders at $229k to $254k and 2022s at $278k to $290k, so every ask here is $15k to $30k rich. Start at $255k. Skip the $230k McLaren Chicago car: CARFAX shows a branded title.
shift: McLaren Chicago 2020 at $230,300 and Live Car Orlando: branded titles. Autodynamics Houston: damage reported. Lapin Scottsdale: 5 owners and a duplicate title
sources: Listings and full CARFAX reports from carfax.com dealer listings (free reports), read Nov 7, 2026. Sold results from classic.com and Cars & Bids via Codex, Nov 7. Days listed from CARFAX first-seen dates. MSRP from the CARFAX listing where shown; iPacket refused these VINs.

cars.name: Ilusso Costa Mesa
cars.rep: No repairs reported. McLaren Chicago and Volvo/McLaren Palo Alto service, regular detailing. No accidents, clean title.
tl: Sold new at Jaguar Palm Beach; owner 1, Ohio, personal lease
McLaren Chicago service Nov 2022, Aug 2024, Dec 2024; kept detailed
Owner 2, Oregon. Service at McLaren SF (Palo Alto) and Northwest Autohaus, 2025
Listed at Ilusso Costa Mesa, 5,217 mi
cars.verdict: My pick. A 2021 with 5,287 mi, dealer-serviced, no repairs, and it sits 15 minutes away at Ilusso, where we already have a contact. Ask $279,900; 2022 Spider sales ran $278k to $290k, 2020-21s $229k to $254k, so offer $255k to $260k.

rev.good: Local; you can see it today.
rev.bad: iLusso passed on our Turbo S at $202k.
